description: One-way push of committed planner work (firm and pencil tasks, maintenance visits, projected contract visits, day notes and unavailable blocks) to Sapphire's shared Google Calendars. ERPNext is the only source of truth: an edit made in Google is undone.

fields.description: The master switch. Off: nothing is sent to Google and no job is queued. The preview works either way.
fields.label: Push committed work to Google Calendar

fields.description: Sync signs in as one Google account through Google Settings' OAuth client. That account must be able to make changes to all three calendars.
fields.label: Google account

fields.description: Written by Authorize with Google. Never shown and never logged.
fields.label: Refresh token

fields.description: Calendar IDs (Google Calendar > Settings > Integrate calendar > Calendar ID), or use Pick calendars once authorized.
fields.label: Calendars

fields.description: Project tasks (firm and pencil) and day notes.
fields.label: Projects calendar ID

fields.description: Maintenance visits and projected contract visits.
fields.label: Maintenance calendar ID

fields.description: Unavailable blocks from the planners go out to it (never the block's note); with Read time off from Google on, people's own time off on it comes in.
fields.label: Company Holidays & Vacations calendar ID

fields.description: The nightly full repair and Re-sync everything cover this many days before today...
fields.label: Repair window: days back

fields.description: Read the time off people put on the Company Holidays & Vacations calendar by hand ("Austin Off", "Clegg - ooo") into the planners as Unavailable blocks. Needs the switch above on, an authorized account and the Company Holidays & Vacations calendar ID.
fields.label: Time off from Google

fields.description: Every 10 minutes (and the whole window nightly): a name plus off / OOO / out / vacation / PTO / sick / leave becomes an Unavailable block for that person; "Company holiday" for everyone; birthdays are skipped; anything unclear waits in Calendar Time Off Review. Blocks read in are read-only and never written back out.
fields.label: Read time off from Google

fields.description: Who gets a bell when time off read in lands on booked work, and when events wait for review. Empty: whoever authorized the Google account.
fields.label: Time off alerts

fields.description: Defaults: Design 3 Grape, Build 9 Blueberry, Service 10 Basil, Events 6 Tangerine, Delivery 5 Banana, Day Note 8 Graphite, Unavailable 8 Graphite. A row here overrides one default.
fields.label: Colors

fields.description: {calendar ID: Google nextSyncToken}. Not secret; losing it costs one full listing.
fields.label: Incremental sync tokens

fields.description: Google nextSyncToken for the time-off read (its query differs from snap-back's). Not secret; losing it costs one full listing.
fields.label: Time-off sync token

name: Calendar Sync Settings
